title: Library copies and loan history
summary: Separate shared catalog metadata from physical copies, with a retained borrowing history for each copy.

models.name: Book
models.description: A catalog title. Physical copies share this metadata.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Catalog identity; preserve existing identifiers where possible.

models.name: Copy
models.description: One physical copy of a Book. Physical identity and loan evidence belong here, not on the shared title.

fields.name: bookId
fields.description: The shared catalog title for this copy.

fields.name: code
constraints: Uniqueness does not require gap-free numbering

fields.name: availability
fields.description: Computed from whether an active Loan exists.

models.name: Loan
models.description: One borrowing event for one physical Copy; completed events form its history.

fields.name: borrowerName
fields.description: Borrower name recorded at checkout. Proposed requirement for new loans only.

fields.name: borrowerReference
fields.description: Optional borrower reference; absence means unrecorded.

fields.name: checkedOutAt
fields.description: Time the copy was lent; required for new loans.
constraints: Preserve historical gaps rather than invent times

fields.name: dueAt
fields.description: Proposed required return deadline for new loans.

fields.name: returnedAt
fields.description: Absent while active; set when returning the copy.

fields.name: checkoutConditionNotes
fields.description: Condition recorded at checkout; missing means unrecorded.

fields.name: returnConditionNotes
fields.description: Condition recorded on return; missing means unrecorded.

relationships.description: Each Copy belongs to exactly one Book. Whether a Book may have no copies is proposed, not confirmed.
Each Loan belongs to exactly one Copy. A Copy may have many completed Loans but at most one active Loan.

lifecycle: Adding a Copy assigns a permanent unique code.
Checkout creates an active Loan; return completes it.
Completed Loans are immutable under the proposed policy; correction handling remains unresolved.
invariants: Enforce one active Loan per Copy atomically when saving, not only in the UI.
Copies and loan history cannot be deleted through the app.
migration: Each existing book entry gains one Copy, and its existing Loans attach to that Copy.
Do not merge possibly duplicated titles without review.
Preserve identifiers and historical gaps. No reset, deletion or reseeding is authorized.
assumptions: The listed fields are conceptual proposals, not storage-specific column definitions.
New-loan requirements do not imply fabricating missing historical values.

questions.prompt: Can a Book exist before any copies are added?
Must new loans include borrower name and due date?
How should incorrect completed loans be corrected while retaining history?
How should lost or damaged copies be retired, and can active loans be renewed?
